findings.title: Berth labels are very small and low in contrast

location.description: The berth numbers (N1 to W6) inside the green squares of the pontoon plan, top right.

findings.viewer_experience: A harbour master scanning the plan to find a berth has to lean in to read the small dark-grey numbers on pale green.

current.value: About 12 px dark grey numbers on pale green squares.

findings.target: Berth numbers readable at a glance, with text contrast of at least 4.5:1.
findings.fix_direction: Raise the berth label size and darken the text so the numbers read without effort.

closed_when.check: Look at the plan: each berth number is clearly legible against its square.

findings.title: The three feature blocks have little separation from each other

location.description: The row of three short feature blocks under the hero, below the thin rule.

findings.viewer_experience: The three blocks read as one run of small text; the eye does not stop on any one of them.

current.value: Three columns of small text with equal weight and wide gaps.

findings.target: Each block reads as its own item with a heading that is clearly stronger than its text.
findings.fix_direction: Strengthen the block headings against the body text so each item is easy to pick out.

closed_when.check: Look at the row: each heading is clearly stronger than the text beneath it.
